lesson: The system is consistently entering against high-velocity momentum, mistaking exhaustion for a reversal without waiting for a Wyckoff Spring or Change of Character (CHoCH). All three trades failed by attempting to front-run volatility rather than waiting for structural confirmation.
adjustment: Mandate a confirmed Market Structure Shift (MSS) on the 1h timeframe before entering any position, ignoring RSI/Bollinger overextension signals until the trend has demonstrably broken.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI/Bollinger mean-reversion signals LESS during high-velocity volume spikes.
